name: Maltodextrin
what_is: An ultra-processed carbohydrate powder made from the partial breakdown of starches.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because it is a rapidly digestible carbohydrate that behaves like sugar once digested, while not being classified as a free sugar under WHO criteria. It frequently appears in products that avoid the word sugar on the label.
can_1: Detect maltodextrin and flag it as a marker of ultra-processing.
can_2: Flag its presence as a rapidly digestible carbohydrate, distinct from WHO free sugars.
cannot_1: Determine the botanical starch source (e.g., corn, wheat, or tapioca) unless explicitly declared.
cannot_2: Ascertain the glycemic index or the molecular chain length of the specific maltodextrin used.
title: Maltodextrin
description: An ultra-processed carbohydrate powder made from the partial breakdown of starches.
